// diagnostic

E0629

`{name}` is a module, not a value

What

`{name}` is a module, not a value

Why

A module groups declarations; it has no value to bind, pass, return, store or print.

Fix

Use one of its items instead, such as `{name}.item` or a call `{name}.function(…)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0629: tests/ui/module_used_as_value/stderr.

 10 | pick: fn() -> String { text }
    |                        ^^^^
 Why: A module groups declarations; it has no value to bind, pass, return, store or print.
 Fix: Use one of its items instead, such as `text.item` or a call `text.function(…)`.
